change: Use explicit planar distance for 2D canvas selection and entity snap candidate search/order, retaining the actual candidate elevation in snap events. Existing storage queries retain 3D behavior by default; planar projection is opt-in.
validation: The pre-change viewer regression failed to select and snap a point at (2,3,70) from the planar cursor (2,3).

The focused control selects that point, snaps to its actual elevation in preference to a nearby planar point, checks empty-space fallback, and confirms default 3D and explicit planar storage query behavior.
76 BuilderTest, EntityBuilderTest, SelectionTest and CanvasScaleTest cases pass on macOS ARM64, including locked and hidden layer checks, retry, undo/redo and planar snapping.
limitations: The control is headless and covers elevated POINT picking; native GUI interaction and general nonplanar curves, intersections, other producers and platforms remain to be qualified.
The planar search uses the entity nearest-path elevation as the snap-query elevation; mixed-elevation snap candidates require separate evidence.
